subject: Music Production
title: The Loudness War Explained
description: Learn The Loudness War Explained in one minute.

hook.text: Starting in the 1990s, producers began making each new album louder than the last.

buildup.text: They used heavy compression to squash dynamic range and push average volume to the maximum.

discovery.text: Louder tracks grab attention on radio, but extreme compression removes the quiet musical moments.

twist.text: Streaming platforms now normalize loudness automatically, making the loudness war pointless.

climax.text: Modern producers are returning to wider dynamics now that loudness no longer wins the attention race.

punchline.text: Streaming ended the war by making everything equal.

quiz.question: Why did the loudness war become pointless?
options: Speakers could not handle the volume
